label: Merch Formats
description: The printed object the artwork is FOR — sticker sheet, tee front, tote, pin. Each states the print constraints that decide whether a design survives manufacture: bleed, colour count, cut line and where the thing is looked at.

items.name: sticker-diecut-sheet
items.text: a die-cut sticker sheet: several related stickers laid out on one page, each with a thick white cut border and a subtle drop shadow, flat vinyl-ready colour
items.text_short: die-cut sticker sheet, white cut borders

items.name: tee-front-print
items.text: a t-shirt front print: one centred graphic sized to the chest, limited screen-print palette, no gradients finer than the mesh can hold, transparent background
items.text_short: tee front print, limited screen palette

items.name: tote-canvas
items.text: a canvas tote print: single-colour design on natural cotton, generous margins, artwork that reads from across a market

items.name: enamel-pin
items.text: a hard enamel pin design: bold metal outlines separating every colour field, no gradients, compact silhouette that survives at 35mm

items.name: mug-wrap
items.text: a mug wrap print: artwork laid out as a continuous band that meets itself at the handle, safe margins top and bottom

items.name: poster-a2
items.text: an A2 poster: one dominant image with a clear focal hierarchy and space reserved for a title block, print-resolution detail
items.text_short: A2 poster, dominant image, title space

items.name: phone-case
items.text: a phone case print: vertical composition with the camera cut-out kept clear, artwork that still reads at palm size
items.text_short: phone case print, camera cut-out clear

items.name: embroidered-patch
items.text: an embroidered patch: shapes simplified to what a needle can hold, merrowed border, satin-stitch highlights, limited thread colours
